name: shadPS4 system-managed area reservation [SYSTEM_MANAGED_MIN, SYSTEM_MANAGED_MAX] (0x400000..0x7FFFFBFFF)
required_postconditions: SearchFree() treats SystemManagedVirtualBase() as the lowest searchable address, so a relocated base silently moves every default-placed guest mapping

failure_sink.description: reservation failure is detected only as MAP_FAILED at lines 677-678 and terminates via `throw std::bad_alloc{}` at line 680. On the non-Apple POSIX x86-64 path this sub-range is not reserved by its own mmap: lines 657-661 issue ONE mmap at SYSTEM_MANAGED_MIN of size system_managed_size + system_reserved_size + user_size, and system_managed_base is simply the head of it (line 662). Only the Apple/x86-64 path reserves this range with a dedicated mmap (line 649).

source_locations.symbol: .zerofill SYSTEM_MANAGED,...,0x7FFBFC000 - independently confirms the computed size
Impl::Impl - dedicated mmap(SYSTEM_MANAGED_MIN, system_managed_size, ..., MAP_FIXED) on the Apple/x86-64 path
